ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with approximately 10-15% coverage of high-intensity (white) punctate regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Numerous high-contrast white circular and semi-circular spots distributed across both lobes, with higher density clusters located at the distal tips and along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-55 degrees, transitioning into a deep central cleft.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and narrow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle attachment) localized primarily on the outer thirds of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal white scarring/pigmentation across the ventral surface; highly irregular, jagged morphology on the distal tip of the left lobe (viewer perspective).
other_distinctive_markers: Notable asymmetrical 'step-like' serration pattern on the outer margin of the left lobe tip.
